_comment: 🔒️ Shrink-only migration baseline. `unmanagedTests` counts executable test files that still live outside the canonical owner-root test tree, per area. The contract phase fails when a count GROWS; removing a legacy test in the same change that adds its replacement case always passes. An owner may not be declared migrated while its area count is above zero. Ticket 26/08/23/END-TO-END-TESTING-REFACTOR.
